user.title: Treatment plant
user.description: Basic plant and design-capacity information. Nominal EO is the rated plant capacity, not current occupant count or current load.

data_description.name: Display name used for the Home Assistant device and its entities.
data_description.model: Optional manufacturer model designation; informational only.
data_description.plant_type: Select the general process type. It does not automatically choose a blower schedule.
data_description.nominal_eo: Manufacturer-rated plant design capacity in equivalent inhabitants (EO). This is neither current occupant count nor current load. Operating mode represents current relative load independently of this capacity.
data_description.tank_volume_l: Total treatment-tank volume in liters; stored as plant information.

household.title: Household and load
household.description: Occupant count and estimated current load (EO) are separate from nominal plant design capacity. Leave an unknown value at zero.

data_description.occupants: Actual number of regular occupants. Zero means unknown. This does not replace nominal plant capacity (nominal_eo).
data_description.estimated_eo: Optional estimate of current organic/hydraulic load in EO. Zero means unknown. This is separate from nominal plant capacity and is not used by the V1 aeration calculation.
data_description.load_factor: Optional manual multiplier describing relative load. Version 0.1 stores it for future load models and does not apply it to AUTO yet.

blower.title: Blower
blower.description: Select the Home Assistant entity that controls only the aeration blower. Nameplate values are optional and informational.

data_description.blower_device_id: Select the complete smart-plug device. The integration automatically discovers its blower power switch.
data_description.blower_power_w: Optional rated electrical input from the blower nameplate, in watts; informational only.
data_description.blower_airflow_l_min: Optional rated airflow from the blower nameplate, in liters per minute; informational only.
data_description.blower_pressure_mbar: Optional rated operating pressure, in millibars; informational only.

pump.title: Wastewater/sludge pump monitoring
pump.description: The integration never controls this pump. Select a power sensor for float-controlled pumps, or a state entity.

data_description.pump_device_id: Select the complete outlet-pump smart plug. The integration automatically uses its power sensor and never controls its switch.
data_description.pump_power_threshold_w: The pump is considered running when measured power is at or above this value. Choose it above standby noise and below stable running power.
data_description.volume_per_cycle_l: Estimated discharged liters assigned to every validated pump start. This is an estimate, not a flow measurement.
data_description.pump_min_runtime_s: Activity shorter than this duration is ignored as noise or a startup transient.

optional.title: Optional inputs
optional.description: Assign optional inlet-pump and alarm entities, or leave them empty when they are not available.

data_description.inlet_device_id: Select the complete inlet-pump smart plug. The integration automatically uses its power sensor and does not control the pump.
data_description.alarm_entity: Optional alarm control panel used by AUTO to distinguish night, short absence and prolonged absence.
data_description.away_timeout_h: Continuous armed-away duration after which AUTO changes from Low load to Eco / Holiday.

auto.title: AUTO strategy
auto.description: These are transparent application heuristics, not universal treatment-engineering requirements.

data_description.use_alarm: Allow alarm states and transitions to influence AUTO mode selection.
data_description.use_pump_activity: Allow recent validated pump-start counts to influence AUTO mode selection.
data_description.use_volume: Allow estimated pumped volume over the last 24 hours to influence AUTO mode selection.
data_description.high_starts_hour: This many validated starts within one hour selects Higher load when pump activity is enabled.
data_description.medium_volume_day_l: At or above this estimated 24-hour volume, AUTO selects Normal operation unless a higher-priority rule applies.
data_description.high_volume_day_l: At or above this estimated 24-hour volume, AUTO selects Higher load. It must not be lower than the normal-load threshold.
data_description.inactivity_timeout_h: After this many hours without a validated pump start, AUTO may select Eco / Holiday.
data_description.auto_stabilization_min: A load-driven candidate must remain stable for this long before AUTO changes mode. Prolonged absence and inactivity decisions are already time-qualified.

schedules.title: Blower schedules
schedules.description: Defaults are inspired by one ECOkocka configuration and must be checked for your plant.

data_description.normal_off: Minutes the blower remains off in each Normal operation cycle.
data_description.eco_on: Minutes the blower remains on in each Eco / Holiday cycle.
data_description.eco_off: Minutes the blower remains off in each Eco / Holiday cycle.
data_description.heavy_load_off: Minutes the blower remains off in each Higher load cycle.
data_description.low_load_on: Minutes the blower remains on in each Low load cycle.
data_description.low_load_off: Minutes the blower remains off in each Low load cycle.
data_description.heavy_load_on: Minutes the blower remains on in each Higher load cycle.
data_description.normal_on: Minutes the blower remains on in each Normal operation cycle.

data_description.aeration_configuration: Manual uses your four schedules. Automatic uses tank volume, blower airflow and nominal plant capacity (EO). Operating mode independently represents relative load: Normal 1.0, Low load 1/3, Higher load 1.25; Eco uses a separate 10/470-minute baseline. The 420-minute ON ceiling is a technical/heuristic limit, not a technologically validated boundary.

method.title: Aeration configuration method
method.description: Choose how blower ON/OFF times are obtained. Manufacturer configuration is prepared architecturally but is not available yet.

data_description.mode_selection: MANUAL keeps the chosen mode; AUTO evaluates alarm, pump activity and estimated volume.
data_description.manual_operating_mode: The mode used whenever mode selection is MANUAL.

mode_selection.title: Operating mode selection
mode_selection.description: Choose whether you select one of the four fixed modes or let AUTO select it from configured Home Assistant signals.

error.threshold_order: The high volume threshold must be at least the normal threshold.
error.device_not_found: The selected device no longer exists in Home Assistant.
error.blower_switch_missing: The blower device has no switch entity. Select a device with a controllable switch.
error.blower_switch_ambiguous: The blower device has multiple switches. Select a dedicated smart plug with one switch.
error.pump_power_missing: The pump device has no power sensor with device_class power.
error.pump_power_ambiguous: The pump device has multiple power sensors. Select a dedicated smart plug with one power sensor.
error.airflow_required: Automatic aeration requires a blower airflow greater than zero.

settings.title: AUTO and pump settings
settings.description: Tune pump detection and the transparent signals used by AUTO mode. These thresholds are site-specific heuristics.

data_description.away_timeout_h: Continuous armed-away duration after which AUTO changes from Low load to Eco / Holiday.
data_description.high_starts_hour: This many validated starts within one hour selects Higher load when pump activity is enabled.
data_description.medium_volume_day_l: At or above this estimated 24-hour volume, AUTO selects Normal operation unless a higher-priority rule applies.
data_description.high_volume_day_l: At or above this estimated 24-hour volume, AUTO selects Higher load. It must not be lower than the normal-load threshold.
data_description.inactivity_timeout_h: After this many hours without a validated pump start, AUTO may select Eco / Holiday.
data_description.volume_per_cycle_l: Estimated discharged liters assigned to every validated pump start. This is an estimate, not a flow measurement.
data_description.pump_power_threshold_w: The pump is considered running when measured power is at or above this value. Choose it above standby noise and below stable running power.
data_description.use_alarm: Allow alarm states and transitions to influence AUTO mode selection.
data_description.use_pump_activity: Allow recent validated pump-start counts to influence AUTO mode selection.
data_description.use_volume: Allow estimated pumped volume over the last 24 hours to influence AUTO mode selection.
data_description.auto_stabilization_min: Required persistence of a load-driven candidate before AUTO changes mode.
data_description.aeration_configuration: Manual schedules or transparent V1 automatic calculation. Manufacturer configuration is coming later.
data_description.mode_selection: MANUAL keeps your selected operating mode; AUTO selects it from enabled signals.
data_description.manual_operating_mode: Mode used whenever mode selection is MANUAL.

schedules.title: Blower schedules
schedules.description: Set the blower ON and OFF duration for each operating mode. Verify the values against the plant manufacturer's guidance.

data_description.normal_off: Minutes the blower remains off in each Normal operation cycle.
data_description.eco_on: Minutes the blower remains on in each Eco / Holiday cycle.
data_description.eco_off: Minutes the blower remains off in each Eco / Holiday cycle.
data_description.heavy_load_off: Minutes the blower remains off in each Higher load cycle.
data_description.low_load_on: Minutes the blower remains on in each Low load cycle.
data_description.low_load_off: Minutes the blower remains off in each Low load cycle.
data_description.heavy_load_on: Minutes the blower remains on in each Higher load cycle.
data_description.normal_on: Minutes the blower remains on in each Normal operation cycle.

devices.title: Power devices
devices.description: Change the smart plugs assigned to the blower and pumps. The integration reloads automatically after saving.

data_description.blower_device_id: Must expose exactly one controllable switch.
data_description.pump_device_id: Must expose exactly one power sensor; its switch is never controlled.
data_description.inlet_device_id: Optional device with one power sensor; its switch is never controlled.

error.device_not_found: The selected device no longer exists in Home Assistant.
error.blower_switch_missing: The blower device has no switch entity. Select a device with a controllable switch.
error.blower_switch_ambiguous: The blower device has multiple switches. Select a dedicated smart plug with one switch.

error.pump_power_ambiguous: The pump device has multiple power sensors. Select a dedicated smart plug with one power sensor.
